morbi.headline: Morbi faces operational stress with unit shutdowns, high inventory, and rising fuel costs
what_changed: Morbi ceramic production cycle slowed down, resulting in full warehouses of unsold stock and 15% of units shutting down
Attempts to mitigate or control elevated propane gas prices have failed, increasing operational challenges
Proposed ceramic testing laboratory for Bikaner's 200 clay mines is being relocated to Jaipur due to building possession delays

Rising propane gas prices remain uncontrolled, straining operational costs for cluster units [64076d83f199]

Propane gas price movements and impact on unit-level operating margins and debt serviceability
Operational continuity and capacity utilization metrics to identify further potential unit closures

surat.headline: Surat textile faces severe input cost and labor shocks while diamond sector shows demand recovery.
what_changed: Surat textile trade dropped 50% due to a doubling of coal prices impacting processing units [16a5b570eb9e].
Textile industry faced a 66% surge in yarn prices and mandatory 15-day payment rules ahead of Diwali [b62552cc0c7d, 0c72a246c955].
Diamond industry shortened its Diwali vacation for the first time in four years due to improved demand [2b47ff4fa01a].
stress_signals: Four cheating cases and a Rs 15.57 crore textile fraud case filed involving yarn, fabric, and diamond traders [2718cba9f837, cf2229091691].
Weavers shifting to a weekly two-day holiday amid recessionary pressures and strict 15-day yarn payment rules [0c72a246c955, 28ff6df05700].
Intense worker agitations, leave disputes, 'Gaon Chalo' protests, and early Diwali worker exodus creating operational disruptions [6b7974c7f88e, 73dfcce5d3f4, b0d8a5269e4e].
Fires reported at a textile and yarn unit in Pipodara GIDC and a diamond premises [8103ae8facb8, 42bc4e18e52d].
improvement_signals: Diamond sector boom raising hopes for a rollback of worker wage cuts and shortened Diwali holidays [ff0f473e0921, 2b47ff4fa01a].
Technological advancements highlighted by a Surat-made fabric-coated balloon airship tested for border surveillance [5a6c6ad01d9d].
Establishment of ICA-GemLab's first Indian laboratory and MANTRA positioning Surat as a global testing hub [26bd1ecd549c, 0b9a805766c6].
what_to_watch: Monitor cash flow compression and debt servicing capabilities in weaving and processing units facing high coal and yarn prices [b62552cc0c7d, 16a5b570eb9e].
Track account-level repayment compliance given the strict 15-day yarn payment terms and FOSTTA trader advisories [0c72a246c955, 9013ae33515c].
Observe labor availability and the potential escalation of wage and leave disputes post-Diwali [6b7974c7f88e, a9383cbae2cf].
